long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Kazan, Tatarstan, Dashin studied banking at Kazan Federal University and worked in a bank's foreign-exchange department before becoming an accountant for an oil company. Russia's 1998 financial crisis drew him back to currency markets, where he established Alpari as online retail trading was emerging.

He founded Cyprus-based FXTM before launching a unified group in 2020 to extend his financial-technology businesses. The group now operates retail investing and trading brands alongside an institutional liquidity service. Its products cover foreign exchange, equities, commodities and crypto across emerging markets. Dashin remains based in Cyprus, where he also established a family foundation supporting education, health and community programmes.
